scope: 2 output tiles x4 source-ID PEs, P4/F_live1/C384, all T10 GP-to-PSN output; source-ready local-memory boundary

shared_resources.state_per_PE: 56 x S15 +56 valid; P4/R<=7 uses first28 words
shared_resources.consumer_per_PE: 7 x S15 cache, U24, ten gates; existing scalar/member W10 partial logic; one Acc24 shared by synaptic commits and scalar CSD PSN
shared_resources.program: 4 replicas x256 x16, one per source-ID broadcast to both tiles
shared_resources.barrier: same-source-ID both tiles finish S before PSN; common source row waits both tile consumed/skipped

added_to_original_intersection.logic: shared metadata arbitration/return decode; two threshold comparisons; four indexed weight-bit selectors per tile with fanout; source-advance rank increments using original pointer increment paths; native/direct and sparse modes have same module resources

lazy_increment.control_logic: eight9bit prefix index increments/comparisons plus indexed bitmap inputs; pointer rank increments reuse prior control state; no384bit popcount
lazy_increment.arithmetic_limit: same main GP/PSN ALUs/CSA and memory ports; extra control logic is not an equal-area proof

formats.mode1: uint16 nnz + nnz x {uint16 index, signedW8}
formats.mode2: 48B bitmap + nnz signedW8; rank cursor generates48+prefix address
formats.mode3: uint16 nnz + dense384 if nnz>=334 else bitmap48+nnz values
formats.mode4: same image as3; metadata read only after actual first live source row; bounded prefix catchup for compressed branch

metadata_service.construction: Static W-only image construction outside measured endpoint; no source intersection in supplied image; every runtime metadata/value byte uses real W request/address/response

unproven: Equal synthesized area, SRAM timing, Fmax or energy
Full original GustavSNN chip/8x8 array/F_cache/complete layer
Input producer quantization and external cold source/W/program DMA
FC2/BN2/shortcut/full FFN; official author RTL equivalence
threshold_note: Implemented334 is a preset near-crossing threshold; original planning arithmetic was wrong:2+384=2+48+nnz crosses at336.333/334 is the implementation branch boundary; measuredRTL/results retained, no retrospective tuning.
